ui.notice_body: I can help you find hospitals and specialists, and navigate appointments, pre-admission and emergency information. I do not diagnose medical conditions.

ui.welcome: Hello. I am the Netcare Help Assistant. Say “Hi Netcare” once to start a voice conversation, or just type. I can find hospitals near you, list them by province, and explain how bookings and admissions work.

booking.title: Requesting an appointment
booking.message:
Appointments cannot be confirmed in this chat. Netcare appointmed does the booking for you at no charge, with specialists, GPs and dentists at Netcare hospitals, Medicross centres and Akeso facilities.

Have this ready:
• The patient's full name and ID number, or passport
• Medical aid scheme, plan and membership number, or say you are paying privately
• What you need: the specialty, or the reason for the visit
• Where you want to be seen: town, suburb or hospital
• Preferred dates and times
• A referral letter from your GP, if you have one

Appointmed matches you to a practitioner contracted to your scheme where possible, then phones you back to confirm.
booking.speech: Netcare cannot be booked from this chat, but Netcare appointmed will book it for you, free of charge. Call 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5, or fill in the online request form. Have ready the patient's name and I D number, the medical aid name and membership number, the type of specialist or reason for the visit, the area you want to be seen in, and your preferred dates and times. Appointmed phones you back to confirm.

preadmission.title: Pre-admission and what to bring
preadmission.message:
Pre-admission is the paperwork done before the day, so you do not queue. Submit it at least 48 hours ahead, online through MyNetcare Online or on a form from the hospital.

Bring on the day:
• Your ID document or passport
• Your medical aid card and the scheme's pre-authorisation number
• Your doctor's admission letter or booking form
• A list of every medicine you take, including chronic, herbal and traditional medicine
• Previous X-rays, scans or results if your doctor asked for them

Before you come in:
• Follow your doctor's fasting instructions exactly, or surgery may be delayed or cancelled
• No alcohol the day before, and cut down or stop smoking if you are having a general anaesthetic
• Ask your doctor whether to stop blood thinners or chronic medication
preadmission.speech: Complete your pre-admission at least 48 hours before you are admitted, either online through My Netcare Online or on a form from the hospital reception. On the day, bring your I D document, your medical aid card, the authorisation number from your scheme, your doctor's admission letter, and a list of your current medicines. Your doctor will give you the fasting rules.

emergency.title: Emergency and trauma
emergency.message:
Call Netcare 911 on 082 911 now. They answer 24 hours a day, dispatch ambulances and helicopters, and direct you to the nearest emergency department.

You do not need a booking, a referral or medical aid to be seen in an emergency department. Patients are triaged by how urgent their condition is, not by arrival order.
emergency.speech: If this is an emergency, call Netcare 9 1 1 on 0 8 2, 9 1 1, right now. They answer 24 hours a day and will send an ambulance and direct you to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for this chat.

mental.title: Mental health, Netcare Akeso
mental.message:
Netcare Akeso provides inpatient and outpatient mental health care across South Africa, including crisis admission, and there are free self-assessment tools on the Netcare site.

If you or someone with you is in immediate danger, call 082 911.
mental.speech: Netcare Akeso runs mental health facilities across the country. You can search for a facility near you, or use the free online self assessment tools. If you are in crisis, call Netcare 9 1 1 on 0 8 2, 9 1 1.

maternity.title: Maternity and baby care
maternity.message:
Maternity services include antenatal care and classes, high-risk maternal and foetal care, labour and delivery, neonatal ICU, postnatal support and the Ncelisa human milk banks.

If your waters break or contractions start near your due date, go straight to the maternity ward of the hospital where you are booked. If it is early, or there is bleeding or high blood pressure, phone your obstetrician and go to the emergency department.
maternity.speech: Netcare hospitals offer antenatal classes, maternity wards, neonatal intensive care, mother and baby clinics, and the Ncelisa human milk banks. You can search for a mother and baby clinic near you, and appointmed can book you with an obstetrician.

gap.title: NetcarePlus gap cover
gap.message:
NetcarePlus gap cover helps with the shortfall between what your medical scheme pays and what specialists actually charge for in-hospital treatment. Cover levels, waiting periods and pricing are on the product page.

I cannot advise on which cover suits you. That is a financial decision and NetcarePlus has consultants for it.
gap.speech: NetcarePlus offers gap cover that helps with the shortfall between what your medical aid pays and what specialists charge. Details and pricing are on the NetcarePlus page.

specialist.title: Finding a specialist
specialist.message: Netcare's specialist directory filters by discipline and by area, and shows each doctor's practice, hospital and contact number. Appointmed will then book the appointment for you free of charge on 0860 555 565.
specialist.speech: Search Netcare's specialist directory by discipline and area. Appointmed can then book the appointment for you on 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5.

gp.title: Finding a GP
gp.message: GPs practise from Netcare Medicross medical and dental centres. The directory filters by suburb and shows each centre's hours and phone number. Many centres take walk-ins, but booking ahead is quicker.
gp.speech: G Ps practise from Netcare Medicross centres. Search the directory by suburb for the centre, its hours and its number.

dentist.title: Finding a dentist
dentist.message: Dentists practise from Netcare Medicross medical and dental centres. The directory filters by suburb and shows each centre's hours and phone number.
dentist.speech: Dentists practise from Netcare Medicross centres. Search the directory by suburb for the centre, its hours and its number.

ui.title: Hoe kan ons help?
ui.notice_body: Ek help jou om hospitale en spesialiste te vind, en om afsprake, vooropname en noodinligting te verstaan. Ek diagnoseer nie mediese toestande nie.
ui.placeholder: Vra in jou eie woorde… bv. Netcare hospitale in Gauteng
ui.emergency_lead: Mediese noodgeval? Netcare 911 antwoord 24 uur per dag.
ui.loc_denied: Toegang tot ligging is geweier. Sê vir my jou dorp of provinsie.
ui.loc_fail: Ek kon nie jou ligging kry nie. Sê vir my jou dorp of provinsie.
ui.voice_ready: Stemmodus is gereed. Sê “Hallo Netcare” en vra dan jou vraag. Jy hoef nie Stuur te druk nie.
ui.voice_listening: Ek luister. Praat natuurlik. Sê “Dankie” wanneer ek moet ophou.
ui.voice_wake: Stemmodus luister vir “Hallo Netcare”, “Haai Netcare”, “Haai”, of “Hulp”.
ui.voice_speaking: Netcare praat. Ek luister weer sodra die antwoord klaar is.
ui.voice_unsupported: Outomatiese stemherkenning word nie deur hierdie blaaier ondersteun nie. Jy kan steeds tik.
ui.no_voice_for_lang: Jou toestel het nie 'n stem vir hierdie taal nie, so antwoorde word in Engels gelees.
ui.welcome: Hallo. Ek is die Netcare Hulpassistent. Sê “Hallo Netcare” een keer om 'n stemgesprek te begin, of tik net. Ek kan hospitale naby jou vind, hulle per provinsie lys, en verduidelik hoe besprekings en opnames werk.

booking.title: Om 'n afspraak te vra
booking.message:
Afsprake kan nie in hierdie gesprek bevestig word nie. Netcare appointmed doen die bespreking gratis, met spesialiste, huisdokters en tandartse by Netcare hospitale, Medicross sentrums en Akeso fasiliteite.

Hou dit gereed:
• Die pasiënt se volle naam en ID nommer, of paspoort
• Mediese fonds, plan en lidmaatskapnommer, of sê jy betaal self
• Wat jy nodig het: die spesialiteit, of die rede vir die besoek
• Waar jy gesien wil word: dorp, voorstad of hospitaal
• Voorkeurdatums en -tye
• 'n Verwysingsbrief van jou huisdokter, as jy een het

Appointmed pas jou waar moontlik by 'n praktisyn wat by jou fonds gekontrakteer is, en bel jou dan terug.
booking.speech: Ek kan nie hier bespreek nie, maar Netcare appointmed doen dit gratis vir jou. Bel 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5, of vul die aanlyn vorm in. Hou gereed die pasiënt se naam en I D nommer, die mediese fonds se naam en lidmaatskapnommer, watter spesialis of hoekom jy gaan, die area, en jou voorkeurdatums. Appointmed bel jou terug om te bevestig.

preadmission.title: Vooropname en wat om saam te bring
preadmission.message:
Vooropname is die papierwerk wat voor die dag gedoen word, sodat jy nie tou staan nie. Dien dit ten minste 48 uur vooruit in, aanlyn deur MyNetcare Online of op 'n vorm by die hospitaal.

Bring saam op die dag:
• Jou ID dokument of paspoort
• Jou mediese fonds kaart en die fonds se magtigingsnommer
• Jou dokter se opnamebrief of besprekingsvorm
• 'n Lys van elke medisyne wat jy gebruik, ook chroniese, kruie- en tradisionele medisyne
• Vorige X-strale, skanderings of uitslae as jou dokter dit gevra het

Voor die tyd:
• Volg jou dokter se vasinstruksies presies, anders word die operasie uitgestel of gekanselleer
• Geen alkohol die dag voor nie, en verminder of los rook as jy algemene narkose kry
• Vra jou dokter of jy bloedverdunners of chroniese medisyne moet staak
preadmission.speech: Doen jou vooropname ten minste 48 uur voor jy opgeneem word, aanlyn deur My Netcare Online of op 'n vorm by die hospitaal. Bring op die dag jou I D dokument, jou mediese fonds kaart, die magtigingsnommer van jou fonds, jou dokter se opnamebrief, en 'n lys van al jou medisyne. Jou dokter gee die vasreëls.

emergency.title: Nood en trauma
emergency.message:
Bel Netcare 911 nou op 082 911. Hulle antwoord 24 uur per dag, stuur ambulanse en helikopters, en wys jou na die naaste noodeenheid.

Jy het nie 'n bespreking, verwysing of mediese fonds nodig om by 'n noodeenheid gesien te word nie. Pasiënte word volgens dringendheid gesien, nie volgens aankoms nie.
emergency.speech: As dit 'n noodgeval is, bel Netcare 9 1 1 nou op 0 8 2, 9 1 1. Hulle antwoord 24 uur per dag, stuur 'n ambulans en wys jou na die naaste noodeenheid. Moenie vir hierdie gesprek wag nie.

mental.title: Geestesgesondheid, Netcare Akeso
mental.message:
Netcare Akeso bied binne- en buitepasiënt geestesgesondheidsorg regoor Suid-Afrika, insluitend krisisopname, en daar is gratis selfassesseringshulpmiddels op die Netcare webwerf.

As jy of iemand by jou in onmiddellike gevaar is, bel 082 911.
mental.speech: Netcare Akeso het geestesgesondheidsfasiliteite regoor die land. Jy kan 'n fasiliteit naby jou soek, of die gratis aanlyn selfassessering gebruik. As dit 'n krisis is, bel Netcare 9 1 1 op 0 8 2, 9 1 1.

maternity.title: Kraam- en babasorg
maternity.message:
Kraamdienste sluit in voorgeboortesorg en -klasse, hoërisiko moeder- en fetale sorg, kraam, neonatale ICU, nageboortesorg en die Ncelisa melkbanke.

As jou water breek of weë begin naby jou datum, gaan reguit na die kraamsaal van die hospitaal waar jy bespreek is. As dit vroeg is, of daar is bloeding of hoë bloeddruk, bel jou ginekoloog en gaan na die noodeenheid.
maternity.speech: Netcare hospitale bied voorgeboorteklasse, kraamsale, neonatale intensiewe sorg, moeder-en-baba klinieke, en die Ncelisa melkbanke. Jy kan 'n moeder-en-baba kliniek naby jou soek, en appointmed kan jou by 'n ginekoloog bespreek.

gap.title: NetcarePlus gapingsdekking
gap.message:
NetcarePlus gapingsdekking help met die verskil tussen wat jou mediese fonds betaal en wat spesialiste werklik vra vir behandeling in die hospitaal. Dekkingsvlakke, wagtydperke en pryse is op die produkblad.

Ek kan nie raad gee oor watter dekking jou pas nie. Dit is 'n finansiële besluit en NetcarePlus het konsultante daarvoor.
gap.speech: NetcarePlus bied gapingsdekking wat help met die verskil tussen wat jou mediese fonds betaal en wat spesialiste vra. Besonderhede en pryse is op die NetcarePlus bladsy.

specialist.title: Vind 'n spesialis
specialist.message: Netcare se spesialisgids filtreer volgens dissipline en area, en wys elke dokter se praktyk, hospitaal en nommer. Appointmed bespreek dan gratis vir jou op 0860 555 565.
specialist.speech: Soek Netcare se spesialisgids volgens dissipline en area. Appointmed kan dan vir jou bespreek op 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5.

gp.title: Vind 'n huisdokter
gp.message: Huisdokters praktiseer by Netcare Medicross mediese en tandheelkundige sentrums. Die gids filtreer volgens voorstad en wys elke sentrum se ure en nommer. Baie sentrums neem inloop-pasiënte, maar 'n afspraak is vinniger.
gp.speech: Huisdokters praktiseer by Netcare Medicross sentrums. Soek die gids volgens voorstad vir die sentrum, ure en nommer.

dentist.title: Vind 'n tandarts
dentist.message: Tandartse praktiseer by Netcare Medicross mediese en tandheelkundige sentrums. Die gids filtreer volgens voorstad en wys elke sentrum se ure en nommer.
dentist.speech: Tandartse praktiseer by Netcare Medicross sentrums. Soek die gids volgens voorstad vir die sentrum, ure en nommer.

ui.title: Singakusiza kanjani?
ui.notice_body: Ngingakusiza uthole izibhedlela nochwepheshe, futhi ngichaze ama-apoyintimenti, ukubhalisa ngaphambili nolwazi lwezimo eziphuthumayo. Angihloli izifo.
ui.placeholder: Buza ngamagama akho… isb. izibhedlela zeNetcare eGauteng
ui.emergency_lead: Isimo esiphuthumayo? I-Netcare 911 iphendula amahora angu-24.
ui.loc_denied: Ukufinyelela endaweni kwaliwe. Ngitshele idolobha noma isifundazwe sakho.
ui.loc_fail: Angikwazanga ukuthola indawo okuyo. Ngitshele idolobha noma isifundazwe sakho.
ui.voice_ready: Imodi yezwi ilungile. Yithi “Sawubona Netcare”, bese ubuza umbuzo wakho. Awudingi ukucindezela u-Thumela.
ui.voice_listening: Ngiyalalela. Khuluma ngokwemvelo. Yithi “Ngiyabonga” uma ufuna ngime.
ui.voice_wake: Imodi yezwi ilalele u-“Sawubona Netcare”, “Sanibonani”, noma “Usizo”.
ui.voice_speaking: I-Netcare iyakhuluma. Ngizophinde ngilalele lapho impendulo isiphelile.
ui.voice_unsupported: Ukulalela ngezwi akusekelwa kulesi siphequluli. Usengathayipha umbuzo wakho.
ui.no_voice_for_lang: Idivayisi yakho ayinalo izwi lalolu limi, ngakho izimpendulo zifundwa ngesiNgisi.
ui.welcome: Sawubona. Ngingumsizi weNetcare. Yithi “Sawubona Netcare” kanye ukuze uqale ingxoxo yezwi, noma uthayiphe nje. Ngingathola izibhedlela eduze kwakho, ngizibale ngesifundazwe, futhi ngichaze ukuthi ukubhuka nokwamukelwa kusebenza kanjani.

phrases.near_speak: Nazi izikhungo zeNetcare ezingu-{n} eziseduze nawe.
phrases.and_more: Kukhona ezinye ezingu-{n}. Yithi “funda okusele” ukuze uzizwe.
phrases.stale: Amakheli nezinombolo ziyashintsha. Uhlu lweNetcare oluphilayo yilo olunembile.
phrases.no_location: Ngidinga indawo okuyo ngalokho. Khetha u-“Izibhedlela eduze kwami”, noma ungitshele idolobha noma isifundazwe sakho.
phrases.no_match: Angikwazanga ukuqonda lokho, futhi angifuni ukuqagela. Zama ukusho isifundazwe, isibhedlela, noma uhlobo lodokotela.

booking.title: Ukucela i-apoyintimenti
booking.message:
Ama-apoyintimenti awakwazi ukuqinisekiswa kule ngxoxo. I-Netcare appointmed ikubhukela mahhala, kochwepheshe, odokotela bendawo nabamazinyo ezibhedlela zeNetcare, ezikhungweni zeMedicross nakuma-Akeso.

Kufanele ube nakho lokhu:
• Igama eligcwele nenombolo kamazisi, noma ipasipoti
• Umshwalense wezempilo, uhlelo nenombolo yobulungu, noma usho ukuthi uzizikhokhela
• Odingayo: uhlobo lodokotela, noma isizathu sokuvakasha
• Lapho ufuna ukubonwa khona: idolobha, indawo noma isibhedlela
• Izinsuku nezikhathi ozikhethayo
• Incwadi yokudluliselwa kudokotela, uma unayo

I-appointmed ikufanisa nodokotela onenkontileka nomshwalense wakho lapho kungenzeka, bese ikushayela ukuqinisekisa.
booking.speech: Angikwazi ukubhuka lapha, kodwa i-Netcare appointmed izokubhukela mahhala. Shayela u-0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5, noma ugcwalise ifomu eliku-inthanethi. Kufanele ube nayo igama nenombolo kamazisi wesiguli, igama lomshwalense nenombolo yobulungu, uhlobo lodokotela, indawo, nezinsuku ozikhethayo.

preadmission.title: Ukubhalisa ngaphambili nokumele ukuphathe
preadmission.message:
Ukubhalisa ngaphambili wumsebenzi wamaphepha owenziwa ngaphambi kosuku, ukuze ungami emugqeni. Kuthumele okungenani amahora angu-48 ngaphambili, nge-MyNetcare Online noma ngefomu esibhedlela.

Phatha ngosuku:
• Umazisi wakho noma ipasipoti
• Ikhadi lomshwalense wezempilo nenombolo yemvume
• Incwadi kadokotela yokwamukelwa noma ifomu lokubhuka
• Uhlu lwayo yonke imithi oyithathayo, kufaka eyesikhathi eside neyendabuko
• Ama-X-ray, ama-scan noma imiphumela edlule uma udokotela eyicelile

Ngaphambi kokuza:
• Landela imiyalelo kadokotela yokuzila ukudla ngqo, ngaphandle kwalokho ukuhlinzwa kuyahlehliswa
• Ungaphuzi utshwala ngosuku olwandulelayo, uyeke ukubhema uma uzohlinzwa
• Buza udokotela ukuthi kufanele uyeke yini imithi yegazi noma eyesikhathi eside
preadmission.speech: Gcwalisa ukubhalisa okwandulelayo okungenani amahora angu-48 ngaphambi kokwamukelwa. Ngosuku, phatha umazisi wakho, ikhadi lomshwalense wezempilo, inombolo yemvume, incwadi kadokotela, nohlu lwemithi oyisebenzisayo.

emergency.title: Isimo esiphuthumayo
emergency.message:
Shayela i-Netcare 911 ku-082 911 manje. Baphendula amahora angu-24, bathumela ama-ambulensi nezindiza, futhi bakuqondise emnyangweni wezimo eziphuthumayo oseduze.

Awudingi ukubhuka, incwadi yokudluliselwa noma umshwalense wezempilo ukuze ubonwe emnyangweni wezimo eziphuthumayo. Iziguli zibonwa ngokubaluleka kwesimo sazo.
emergency.speech: Uma kuyisimo esiphuthumayo, shayela i-Netcare 9 1 1 ku-0 8 2, 9 1 1 manje. Baphendula amahora angu-24, bathumela i-ambulensi futhi bakuqondise esibhedlela esiseduze. Ungalindi le ngxoxo.

mental.title: Impilo yengqondo, Netcare Akeso
mental.message:
I-Netcare Akeso inikeza ukunakekelwa kwempilo yengqondo eNingizimu Afrika yonke, kufaka phakathi ukwamukelwa ngokuphuthuma, futhi kunamathuluzi okuzihlola amahhala kuwebhusayithi.

Uma wena noma umuntu onaye esengozini manje, shayela u-082 911.
mental.speech: I-Netcare Akeso inezikhungo zempilo yengqondo ezweni lonke. Ungasesha isikhungo eduze nawe, noma usebenzise amathuluzi okuzihlola amahhala. Uma usenkingeni, shayela i-Netcare 9 1 1 ku-0 8 2, 9 1 1.

maternity.title: Ukunakekelwa kwabakhulelwe nezingane
maternity.message:
Izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka ukunakekelwa namakilasi angaphambi kokubeletha, ukunakekelwa kwabasengozini, ukubeletha, i-ICU yezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, ukusekelwa emva kokubeletha, namabhange obisi e-Ncelisa.

Uma amanzi ephuka noma imihelo iqala eduze kosuku lwakho, hamba ngqo ewodini lokubeletha esibhedlela obhuke kuso. Uma kusenesikhathi, noma kukhona ukopha, shayela udokotela wakho bese uya emnyangweni wezimo eziphuthumayo.
maternity.speech: Izibhedlela zeNetcare zinamakilasi angaphambi kokubeletha, amawodi okubeletha, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, imitholampilo yomama nezingane, namabhange obisi e-Ncelisa.

gap.title: I-NetcarePlus gap cover
gap.message:
I-NetcarePlus gap cover isiza ngomehluko phakathi kwalokho umshwalense wakho okukhokhayo nalokho ochwepheshe abakubiza ngempela ngokwelashwa esibhedlela. Amazinga, izikhathi zokulinda nentengo kusekhasini lomkhiqizo.

Angikwazi ukukweluleka ngokuthi ikuphi okukufanele. Leso yisinqumo sezimali.
gap.speech: I-NetcarePlus inikeza i-gap cover esiza ngomehluko phakathi kwalokho umshwalense wakho okukhokhayo nalokho ochwepheshe abakubizayo. Imininingwane nentengo kukukhasi le-NetcarePlus.

specialist.title: Ukuthola uchwepheshe
specialist.message: Uhlu lochwepheshe lweNetcare luhlunga ngokohlobo nangendawo, futhi lubonisa umtholampilo kadokotela ngamunye, isibhedlela nenombolo. I-appointmed izokubhukela mahhala ku-0860 555 565.
specialist.speech: Sesha uhlu lochwepheshe lweNetcare ngohlobo nangendawo. I-appointmed ingakubhukela ku-0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5.

gp.title: Ukuthola udokotela wendawo
gp.message: Odokotela bendawo basebenza ezikhungweni zeMedicross. Uhlu luhlunga ngendawo futhi lubonisa amahora nezinombolo. Izikhungo eziningi zamukela abangenile, kodwa ukubhuka kusheshisa.
gp.speech: Odokotela bendawo basebenza ezikhungweni zeMedicross. Sesha uhlu ngendawo ukuze uthole isikhungo, amahora nenombolo.

dentist.title: Ukuthola udokotela wamazinyo
dentist.message: Odokotela bamazinyo basebenza ezikhungweni zeMedicross. Uhlu luhlunga ngendawo futhi lubonisa amahora nezinombolo.
dentist.speech: Odokotela bamazinyo basebenza ezikhungweni zeMedicross. Sesha uhlu ngendawo ukuze uthole isikhungo, amahora nenombolo.

ui.title: Re ka o thusa jwang?
ui.notice_body: Nka o thusa ho fumana dipetlele le ditsebi, mme ka hlalosa dikopano, ngolo ya pele le tlhahisoleseding ya tshohanyetso. Ha ke hlahlobe mafu.
ui.placeholder: Botsa ka mantswe a hao… mohl. dipetlele tsa Netcare Gauteng
ui.emergency_lead: Tshohanyetso ya bophelo? Netcare 911 e araba dihora tse 24.
ui.locating: Ke batla sebaka seo o leng ho sona…
ui.loc_denied: Phumantsho ya sebaka e hanne. Mpolelle toropo kapa profinse ya hao.
ui.loc_fail: Ha ke a kgona ho fumana sebaka sa hao. Mpolelle toropo kapa profinse ya hao.
ui.voice_ready: Mokgwa wa lentswe o loketse. Re “Dumela Netcare”, ebe o botsa potso ya hao. Ha o hloke ho tobetsa Romela.
ui.voice_listening: Ke a mamela. Bua ka tlwaelo. Re “Kea leboha” ha o batla ke emise.
ui.voice_wake: Mokgwa wa lentswe o mamela “Dumela Netcare”, “Dumela”, kapa “Thuso”.
ui.voice_speaking: Netcare e a bua. Ke tla mamela hape ha karabo e fela.
ui.voice_unsupported: Ho mamela ka lentswe ha ho tshehetswe ke sebatli sena. O ntse o ka ngola potso ya hao.
ui.no_voice_for_lang: Sesebediswa sa hao ha se na lentswe la puo ena, kahoo dikarabo di balwa ka Senyesemane.
ui.welcome: Dumela. Ke Mothusi wa Netcare. Re “Dumela Netcare” hang ho qala moqoqo wa lentswe, kapa o ngole feela. Nka fumana dipetlele tse haufi le wena, ka di thathamisa ka profinse, mme ka hlalosa hore ho beha letsatsi le ho amohelwa ho sebetsa jwang.

booking.title: Ho kopa letsatsi la kopano
booking.message:
Dikopano di ke ke tsa netefatswa moqoqong ona. Netcare appointmed e o behela letsatsi mahala, le ditsebi, dingaka tsa lelapa le tsa meno dipetleleng tsa Netcare, ditsing tsa Medicross le Akeso.

Eba le tsena:
• Lebitso le felletseng le nomoro ya boitsebiso, kapa phasepoto
• Medical aid, moralo le nomoro ya botho, kapa o bolele hore o itlhokomela
• Seo o se hlokang: mofuta wa setsebi, kapa lebaka la ketelo
• Moo o batlang ho bonwa teng: toropo, lebatowa kapa sepetlele
• Matsatsi le dinako tseo o di ratang
• Lengolo la tsamaiso ho tswa ho ngaka ya hao, ha o na le lona

Appointmed e o fumanela ngaka e nang le konteraka le medical aid ya hao, ebe e o letsetsa ho netefatsa.
booking.speech: Nke ke ka beha letsatsi mona, empa Netcare appointmed e tla o behela mahala. Letsetsa 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5, kapa o tlatse foromo inthaneteng. Eba le lebitso le nomoro ya boitsebiso ya mokudi, lebitso la medical aid le nomoro ya botho, mofuta wa setsebi, sebaka, le matsatsi ao o a ratang.

preadmission.title: Ngolo ya pele le seo o tshwanetseng ho tla le sona
preadmission.message:
Ngolo ya pele ke mesebetsi ya dipampiri e etswang pele ho letsatsi, e le hore o se ke wa ema moleng. E romele bonyane dihora tse 48 esale pele, ka MyNetcare Online kapa ka foromo sepetlele.

Tla le tsena ka letsatsi leo:
• Boitsebiso ba hao kapa phasepoto
• Karete ya medical aid le nomoro ya tumello
• Lengolo la ngaka la ho amohelwa kapa foromo ya kopano
• Lenane la meriana yohle eo o e nwang, ho kenyeletswa ya nako e telele le ya setso
• Di-X-ray, di-scan kapa diphetho tsa pele haeba ngaka e di kopile

Pele o tla:
• Latela ditaelo tsa ngaka tsa ho itima dijo ka ho hlaka, ho seng jwalo opereishene e ya diegiswa
• Se nwe jwala letsatsi le fetileng, mme o tlohele ho tsuba haeba o tla robatswa
• Botsa ngaka hore na o lokela ho emisa meriana ya madi kapa ya nako e telele
preadmission.speech: Tlatsa ngolo ya pele bonyane dihora tse 48 pele o amohelwa. Ka letsatsi leo, tla le boitsebiso ba hao, karete ya medical aid, nomoro ya tumello, lengolo la ngaka, le lenane la meriana eo o e nwang.

emergency.title: Tshohanyetso le trauma
emergency.message:
Letsetsa Netcare 911 ho 082 911 hona jwale. Ba araba dihora tse 24, ba romela diambulense le difofane, mme ba o supisa lefapheng la tshohanyetso le haufi.

Ha o hloke kopano, lengolo la tsamaiso kapa medical aid ho bonwa lefapheng la tshohanyetso. Bakudi ba bonwa ho ya ka bohlokwa ba boemo ba bona.
emergency.speech: Haeba ena ke tshohanyetso, letsetsa Netcare 9 1 1 ho 0 8 2, 9 1 1 hona jwale. Ba araba dihora tse 24, ba romela ambulense mme ba o supisa sepetlele se haufi. O se ke wa emela moqoqo ona.

mental.title: Bophelo ba kelello, Netcare Akeso
mental.message:
Netcare Akeso e fana ka tlhokomelo ya bophelo ba kelello Afrika Borwa hohle, ho kenyeletswa ho amohelwa ka tshohanyetso, mme ho na le disebediswa tsa ho ithekola mahala websaeteng.

Haeba wena kapa motho eo o nang le yena a le kotsing hona jwale, letsetsa 082 911.
mental.speech: Netcare Akeso e na le ditsi tsa bophelo ba kelello naheng yohle. O ka batla setsi se haufi le wena, kapa wa sebedisa disebediswa tsa ho ithekola mahala. Haeba o tsietsing, letsetsa Netcare 9 1 1 ho 0 8 2, 9 1 1.

maternity.title: Tlhokomelo ya bomme le masea
maternity.message:
Ditshebeletso tsa pelehi di kenyeletsa tlhokomelo le dithuto tsa pele ho pelehi, tlhokomelo ya bomme le masea a kotsing, pelehi, ICU ya masea, tshehetso kamora pelehi, le dibanka tsa lebese tsa Ncelisa.

Haeba metsi a hao a phatloha kapa ditlhabi di qala haufi le letsatsi la hao, eya ka kotloloho wateng ya pelehi sepetleleng seo o behilweng ho sona. Haeba e sa le pele, kapa ho na le ho tswa madi, letsetsa ngaka ya hao mme o ye lefapheng la tshohanyetso.
maternity.speech: Dipetlele tsa Netcare di na le dithuto tsa pele ho pelehi, diwate tsa pelehi, tlhokomelo e matla ya masea, ditleliniki tsa bomme le masea, le dibanka tsa lebese tsa Ncelisa.

gap.title: NetcarePlus gap cover
gap.message:
NetcarePlus gap cover e thusa ka phapang pakeng tsa seo medical aid ya hao e se lefang le seo ditsebi di se lefisang ha o le sepetlele. Maemo a tshireletso, dinako tsa ho ema le ditheko di leqepheng la sehlahiswa.

Nke ke ka o eletsa hore na ke efe e o lokelang. Ke qeto ya ditjhelete.
gap.speech: NetcarePlus e fana ka gap cover e thusang ka phapang pakeng tsa seo medical aid ya hao e se lefang le seo ditsebi di se lefisang. Dintlha le ditheko di leqepheng la NetcarePlus.

specialist.title: Ho fumana setsebi
specialist.message: Lenane la ditsebi la Netcare le hlopha ka mofuta le ka sebaka, mme le bontsha praktise ya ngaka, sepetlele le nomoro. Appointmed e tla o behela letsatsi mahala ho 0860 555 565.
specialist.speech: Batla lenane la ditsebi la Netcare ka mofuta le ka sebaka. Appointmed e ka o behela letsatsi ho 0 8 6 0, 5 5 5, 5 6 5.

gp.title: Ho fumana ngaka ya lelapa
gp.message: Dingaka tsa lelapa di sebetsa ditsing tsa Medicross. Lenane le hlopha ka lebatowa mme le bontsha dihora le dinomoro. Ditsi tse ngata di amohela ba tsamayang, empa ho beha letsatsi ho potlakile.
gp.speech: Dingaka tsa lelapa di sebetsa ditsing tsa Medicross. Batla lenane ka lebatowa bakeng sa setsi, dihora le nomoro.
